programs.title: Sense Appeal
programs.desc: Café manager and drag star Spencer wonders if his senses will be sharper than his nails and more heightened than his heels for finding a suitable man; he senses seascapes and urinal cakes.

programs.title: This Is Not Financial Advice
programs.desc: Glauber Contessoto gambles his life savings on a joke cryptocurrency. Two months later, he becomes the Dogecoin Millionaire and an internet legend. While it might seem easy to get rich online, it's even easier to lose it all.

programs.title: Taking Care
programs.desc: Soon after Lauren Miller and Seth Rogen begin dating in 2004, Lauren's mother, Adele is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's; through intimate interviews, "Taking Care" sheds warmth on Alzheimer's through comedy, medical insights, and abiding love.

programs.title: Made From Scratch
programs.desc: T-Pain and his mom make beef pie and talk about the origin of his sound and share old photos; Jhené Aiko and her mom make vegan tacos and talk about their family's fusion of cultures and female influencers.

programs.title: Made From Scratch
programs.desc: Big Boi and his mom Rowena share a family favorite of shrimp and grits as they talk about his latest album, discovering new artists and how he's handling being an empty nester.

programs.title: Made From Scratch
